title: Dear Newcomer: A Letter from Lisbon
logline: Lisbon writes a warm, wry letter to a newcomer opening a coffee stand before inviting the viewer to add their own city to the public lit map.

scenes.action: Hold a warm dark typography card as Lisbon begins the letter.

subtitles.text:
A letter from Lisbon.
I have seen many cafés open.

scenes.card_text:
LISBON, PORTUGAL
A LETTER FROM LISBON

scenes.action: Hold on the Grunds title screen before the licence begins.

subtitles.text:
Hello, newcomer.
Mind the first coffee.

scenes.action: Type Lisbon into the city field, sign the licence, and submit it.

subtitles.text:
You typed my name.
I like the sound of Lisbon.

scenes.action: Hold on the licence with three nearby cafés, the €4 matcha price, and the welcome line visible.

subtitles.text:
Here is my welcome.
The regulars are curious already.

A matcha here runs about €4.
A fair morning, I think.

scenes.action: Slowly orbit the generated street, keeping the LISBON decal, calçada portuguesa paving, and Lisbon-style props in view.

subtitles.text:
Whitewash and blue watch you pass
as the road says LISBON.

scenes.action: Push in on the PRÍNCIPE REAL ticker and the euro-denominated prices.

subtitles.text:
Príncipe Real, says the ticker.
I enjoy hearing it said.

scenes.action: Open the dawn commodity brief and pause over the decision on its news card.

subtitles.text:
At dawn, the brief arrives
with one question attached.

scenes.action: Follow the patrons as they walk up and queue beneath their Portuguese name tags.

subtitles.text:
They remember where they bought.
Give them a reason to return.

scenes.action: Frame the rival stand across the street and settle on its barista, João.

subtitles.text:
Across the street: João.
I suggest you wave first.

scenes.action: Hold on the euro till as the total ticks upward and the day races ahead.

subtitles.text:
The euro till is counting.
The day won't wait.

scenes.action: Present the end-of-week share card with the GRUNDS — LISBON title and printed ?city=lisbon link.

subtitles.text:
One card holds our week:
GRUNDS — LISBON.

Keep the warm light on.
Yours from here, Lisbon.

scenes.action: Move across the lit-cities map, with Lisbon among the six city cards.

subtitles.text:
Lisbon is on the lit map.
Your city could be next.

scenes.action: Replace Lisbon in the link with a different city and let the newly generated street arrive.

subtitles.text:
Type another city into the link.
Watch its street arrive.

scenes.action: Hold the warm dark end card with the city link and the lit-map invitation.
scenes.card_text:
YOUR CITY
grunds.trustfall.xyz/?city=yourcity
Every city typed joins the lit map.

music: A wordless acoustic bed of nylon guitar, brushed drums, and upright bass that remains warm and restrained beneath the letter.
director_notes: 1. Let S3 and S4 breathe; establish place before plot. 2. Cut quicker through brief, regulars, rival, and till. 3. Sign off cleanly on S10, then reserve the final ten seconds for the invitation.
editor_edits: C-end: subtitles dropped; the card text carries the same words
